title: Saul on the Damascus Road Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Damascus Road Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Damascus Road Bible crossword: the light from heaven, “why persecutest thou me”, Ananias and the scales. Free KJV puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: He is on the road with letters in his hand authorising arrests when a light shines round about him and a voice asks a question with his name in it twice. Saul on the Damascus Road covers Acts 9 — the three days without sight, the street called Straight, the disciple sent to him who quite reasonably argues first.
The clue about what fell from his eyes has one of the best answers in the archive, because the KJV's own image is already a metaphor. The closing verse is the question from the light.

clues.text: City he was journeying to with letters
It shined round about him from heaven
Disciple sent to lay hands on him
They fell from his eyes and he received sight

verseText: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
